pageTitle: Aditya Gupta · Product Manager, Consumer Apps
heroSubline: Product Manager · consumer apps & monetization · now building with AI
carinfoBullets: Overhauled the sign-up flow, increasing login completion from 71% to 93% and mapping profiles for 89% of total MAU. This led to a daily increase of 300 orders.

Streamlined the onboarding journey, raising the activation rate by 20% and improving D1 retention from 17% to 22%. Implemented push notifications strategy that boosted the top-of-funnel for four key services by an average of 10%.
Spearheaded "Car Service History Records”, generating ₹30 Lacs in MRR in three months. Onboarded 12 vendors and built a fulfillment dashboard, cutting the TAT for 340+ daily orders to 15 minutes.

Introduced "CarInfo Gold”, a VIP pass that reactivated 24% of churned users, tripled average sessions per user, and achieved a 40% renewal rate among power users. Strategic cross-sells and dynamic pricing boosted ARPU by 14%.

Designed and built multi-gateway payment routing from the ground up, integrating 3 PGs with an auto-switch failover mechanism I ideated, lifting UPI/netbanking success from 45% to 63%, cutting ~₹2.5L/month in failed-transaction losses and growing revenue 16%.
